Spells

What each spell does, by vocation and from lowest to highest mana. Includes instant spells, runes and ammo.

  • Spells need magic level, not level, and you don't have to learn them: with the vocation and the ML you can cast them. Promotions use their vocation's spells.
  • After an attack spell you wait 2 s for the next one; after a healing or support spell, 1 s. Some spells also have their own wait.
  • Spells with their own wait leave an icon in your status bar: lit while the effect lasts, then dimmed with the seconds until you can cast it again. If you try earlier, you get a puff and nothing happens.
  • Runes (type Rune) are made with the spell and a blank rune; the text says what the rune does and the ML needed to use it.
